sequential_dependency.intermediate: Spacing radius k=max(2,measured arm length), used in every inward elbow and tip.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Measure the common arm length of the hollow cross and infer its center.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Trace four handed contour spirals using the measured radius, preserving off-canvas motion and clipping only paint.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The radius controls both the first turn and every repeated inward elbow; the same canvas and center yield different paths under a wrong radius.
